summary: Facepalm: Facepalm scan for 2026-09-26 (window 2026-09-20 to 09-26). My search allowance ran out early, so I'm submitting only one fully verified candidate. It is San Diego's trash-fee billing error, admitted on September 23 and reported by KPBS and NBC 7 San Diego. I opened both pages and checked both quotes against the page text. Montgomery County, MD's misprinted voter guides fit the date window, but I could open only one accepted source, so I set it aside. Most other results I found fell outside the window. Genius: Genius scan for 2026-09-26. My search allowance ran out early, so I worked from ScienceDaily and Space.com listings, using journal DOIs as second sources. I'm submitting two candidates. Each has a peer-reviewed paper published inside the window and two different accepted publishers: (1) a Duke-led trapped-ion quantum simulation of string breaking, in Nature Physics on Sept 23 (NC); (2) a Purdue-led study of Perseverance rover data showing three separate episodes of water in Jezero Crater, including hot fluids, in Communications Earth & Environment on Sept 21 (IN). I opened the Nature pages through dx.doi.org links that redirect to the nature.com addresses cited. Several bigger stories fell outside the window or failed on location. No facepalm story met the standard; nothing published. The verified genius story is on the bench for a later day.
